pages.text: SYN Finance Weekly analyst note on Jangwa Holdings (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 145.75 for JAN9. The note cites steady demand in the holdings sector and cost control at Jangwa Holdings (SYN). Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products.
